BOSS_HINT.gravedigger: Leave the marked burial ground before it roots you, and watch for pits later in the fight.
BOSS_HINT.abbess: Break the skull niches that heal her, and spend your corpses before she draws them in.
BOSS_HINT.congregation: Use the pews to block the Flood Hymn, and step out of the grasping rings.
BOSS_HINT.prelate: Keep out of the Toll ring, the frontal Slam and the marked Bell Rain circles.
BOSS_HINT.saint: Move her off the rot pools where she heals, and kill the Plague Doctors that feed her.
BOSS_HINT.regent: When Conflagration starts, run to a grey ash circle and stay on it.
BOSS_HINT.mire: Fight from the dry hummocks, and spend your corpses before her third phase.
